text.card: A red giant 1,715 parsecs away, 16 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded by TESS, give 1.98 solar masses and 15.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,747 K at its surface.
